Figure 2: Overview of TREE-OF-EXPERIENCE. The upper panel shows the end-to-end learning workflow: given a task τt, the agent retrieves an experience context mctx from the experience memory E , generates the output yt, and updates the utility values Q of the retrieved experiences according to the environment reward R. The lower-left panel illustrates the two-stage experience query process, where a predefined experience selection algorithm first recalls candidate experiences, and an LLM-as-judge module then determines whether the recalled experiences are usable; usable experiences are reranked, while unusable cases trigger the creation of new experiences. The lower-right panel shows the utility update process, where environment feedback is used to update experience utilities Q. The right panel visualizes the tree-structured organization of the experience memory.
